steps.name: at-the-strongbox
steps.transition: the held-back strongbox 1.2 m ahead of the player, faced from its -x side, in frame, its trap unprobed -> the prompt

steps.name: the-lock-screen
steps.transition: E on the armed strongbox -> the lock screen opens, its trap unprobed

steps.name: pick-unprobed
steps.transition: E, then a pick with the trap unfound -> the trap springs: the screen closes, its effect lands, the player flinches, the health bar falls as the shock ticks (held 4.5 s: 3 s of damage)
